text:
maya: Heads-up: staging canary blocked, deploy-bot shows multipart prefetch failing for build 5821 at 14:20 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/5821
ravi: logs show HTTP 504 from artifact-store on shard fetch. snippet:
```
GET /artifacts/sha256:abc123/shard-7/prefetch -> 504
curl: (28) Operation timed out after 30000 ms
```
deploy-bot: auto-retry attempted 3 times and backing off; promotion paused.
tess: Oof. Change-window at 15:00 PT — do we wait or pin previous?
omar: quick options:
- wait ~30m and retry if transient
- manual promote last-good image sha256:def456 to keep window
- quarantine current build and reupload artifacts if corrupt
ravi: storage says a GC/compaction job spiked GET latency at 14:18 and some multipart reads still time out. other objects fine.
sre-oncall: recommend manual promote to avoid missing SLAs, we can follow up with storage for a replay.
maya: decision needed now. who owns release notes?
tess: I'll update notes if we promote. also file a bug linking the quarantined build.
omar: agree — promote last-good image for canary. action: @deploy-bot promote sha256:def456 to canary, keep 5821 quarantined.
deploy-bot: executing: `deploybot promote --env=canary --image=sha256:def456 --reason="artifact prefetch 5821 timeout"`
deploy-bot: promote complete. routing updated, canary now on sha256:def456.
ravi: storage will rehydrate shard and re-run prefetch; we can re-run CI for 5821 after artifacts are confirmed.
tess: updating release notes and the PR with the pin and rationale. cc @product. :memo:
maya: marking change-window met. if storage confirms root cause we’ll open a postmortem. thanks team. :thumbsup:
